prompt: The drone rises straight up and pulls back from five metres to about a hundred and fifty, tilting gently up until the horizon settles on the top third. The hazards keep blinking, the walkers keep walking, and two fireballs bloom one after the other on the city skyline, lighting the smoke from beneath. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so anything moving fast smears with natural motion blur. One continuous shot, no cuts.
